user.title: Set up AC PID Frequency
user.description: The controller self-learns under all operating conditions (defrost, reaction times, minimum modulation) to reliably guide the AC to your target frequency.

data_description.climate_entity: This entity is read (target temperature, mode) and operated in the card. Its integration must support an external room sensor; enter the generated sensor there afterwards.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Sensor or weather entity for weather-aware learning (cold, moderate, mild).
data_description.room_temp_entity: Real room thermometer: used for overheat protection and passed 1:1 to the AC while the controller is off or not heating.
data_description.defrost_entity: Defrost detection. During defrosting the controller pauses completely. Fallback: hvac_action of the climate entity.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Shown small and read-only in the card.

abort.already_configured: An AC PID Frequency controller already exists for this air conditioner.

data_description.climate_entity: Target temperature and mode are read from this entity.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.room_temp_entity: Real room thermometer: overheat protection and pass-through while the controller is off or not heating.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Display only in the card.

tuning.title: Control parameters
tuning.description: Reaction times and minimum modulation are learned automatically. Set safety limits here.

data_description.max_offset: Maximum offset in Kelvin relative to target temperature.
data_description.max_room_overheat: If the real room exceeds target by more than this value, thermal throttling activates.
